title: Keep original observations and refuse fabricated reductions
narrative: Tool output must stay addressable as an immutable observation. A cheaper summary is allowed only when it points at a real observation; fabricated receipts must fail lookup. Compaction happens at semantic boundaries, and action fusion only for predeclared sequences. Compiler deficits remain `fangore_context_compiler_deficit`.
implementation:
`ObservationStore` / `ObservationRef`, `reduce_evidence`, `compact_at_boundary`, and `fuse_actions` under `CtxFlags` in `mechaharness.context_experiments`.

Covers: CTX-01, CTX-02, CTX-03, CTX-04.
